title: Local eventual vanishing of higher direct images
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a quasi-compact separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], and let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. For every point $t\in T$ there are an open neighbourhood $U$ of $t$ and $d\in\mathbf N$ such that $(R^q f_*\mathcal F)|_U=0$ for every $q\ge d$ [pqf-def-cohomology]. No quasi-compactness of T is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01XJ, finite affine neighbourhood bound, specializing the coefficient-independent local statement

proof.text: Separatedness implies quasi-separatedness. Apply the existing coefficient-independent local bound for qcqs morphisms to f and t. It gives U,d, membership of t, and vanishing for every quasi-coherent coefficient in degrees at least d. Specialize its coefficient to F and supply the given quasi-coherence instance. Scheme.Modules.higherDirectImage is definitionally the ordinary rightDerived of the same RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage, so the returned vanishing is exactly the goal.

theorem exists_isZero_higherDirectImage_restrict (t : T) :
    ∃ (U : T.Opens) (d : ℕ), t ∈ U ∧
      ∀ q ≥ d, IsZero (((higherDirectImage f q).obj ℱ).restrict U.ι)
